items.html: Mark Jonkman had been a back-up bowler for the Netherlands, but his stock has risen since. Identical twin of Maurits, Mark is rated as being among the quickest bowlers in his country. He made his debut in 2006, but sustained an injury following the World Cup the next year. He came back strongly with a haul of 5 for 21 against Scotland in an Intercontinental Cup fixture in 2010. He is also a useful lower-order batsman.
